description.narrative: The most significant expected Project-level outcomes are (i) stakeholder effects such as the development of a domestic green fertilizer industry, which is expected to reduce farmers reliance on grey alternatives in Paraguay and the wider region, thereby enhancing the sustainability and security of the food supply chain; and (ii) economy wide effects, which are expected to materialize through direct and indirect job creation. On the market front, the Project is expected to generate strong demonstration effects by illustrating the commercial viability of green fertilizers, thereby catalyzing broader market adoption of sustainable production practices.

The proposed project entails the financing of Paraguays first green hydrogen project, the Villeta 145MW production facility, designed to produce up to 260,000 tons per annum (tpa) of green calcium ammonium nitrate (CAN), a low-carbon fertilizer (the Project). The project is expected to be supported by the Green Climate Fund (GCF) and by IFCs Frontier Opportunities Fund (FOF) as described in the Blended Finance Section.
